content: आवर्तक {%a.%} [आवर्त एव स्वार्थे कन्] Revolving again and again. .{@-कः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a form of cloud personified; जातं वंशे भुवनविदिते पुष्करावर्तकानाम् <ls>Me. 6</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 50</ls>. .²2 Depression above the eye-brows. .²3 A whirlpool. .²4 Revolution. .²5 Revolution of the mind from the influence of the senses. .²6 A curl of hair. .²7 A sort of poisonous insect. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>टाकळा</ns>); .{@-की@} <ab>N.</ab> of a creeping plant (बृहद्दन्ती).
